issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.reason: The adjective 'secure' implies a measurable property of closure reliability (that the lid will not open accidentally during travel). Without authorized evidence defining this performance characteristic, this claim is ambiguous and requires human review.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the subjective adjective 'secure' or provide authorized evidence confirming the lid's security performance.
